scope: Local qualification of the native normalization primitive on protected disposable database copies; not coordinated backup or restore.

local_checks.inventory_test_environment: Regular non-root UID in an isolated network namespace; the default sandbox refused the synthetic Unix socket.

corrected_fixture_failures.cause: SQLite Unix VFS fchown refreshes copied WAL ctime even for unchanged owner/group.
corrected_fixture_failures.correction: Permit WAL ctime refresh only; preserve inode, UID/GID, mode, links, size, mtime and complete byte checks. Main and marker remain ctime-strict.

corrected_fixture_failures.cause: RLIMIT_FSIZE on a WAL input could interrupt shared-memory setup before target creation.
corrected_fixture_failures.correction: Use main-only immutable input for destination-write interruption; retain separate committed-WAL coverage.

limitations: No installed database, operator seed, runtime service or external provider was accessed.
Writer quiescence, complete cross-store checkpoint collection, encryption and funded restore remain unfinished.
The helper never clears INCOMPLETE or recovery fences and never overwrites an output.
Current helper is source-only; root-owned installation and operational acceptance remain open.
